chi_square initializes squared standard-normal draw for odd df or zero for even df,then adds 2*exponential(seed,1) once per pair from k=2 through df inclusive.

合格基準: chi_square initializes squared standard-normal draw for odd df or zero for even df,then adds 2*exponential(seed,1) once per pair from k=2 through df inclusive.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-ERLANG

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

erlangian multiplies exactly k successive uniform(0,1) draws starting from one and returns -mean*log(product)/k.

合格基準: erlangian multiplies exactly k successive uniform(0,1) draws starting from one and returns -mean*log(product)/k.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-EXPONENTIAL

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

exponential draws uniform(0,1); returns -log(sample)*mean for nonzero sample,otherwise zero.

合格基準: exponential draws uniform(0,1); returns -log(sample)*mean for nonzero sample,otherwise zero.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-FLOAT-MANTISSA

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

uniform relies on IEEE float representation: unsigned state shifted right nine OR 0x3f800000,then read float value as double.

合格基準: uniform relies on IEEE float representation: unsigned state shifted right nine OR 0x3f800000,then read float value as double.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-HELPERS

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

Reference helpers accept mutable long* seed and long parameters: uniform(start,end),normal(mean,deviation),exponential(mean),chi_square(df),t(df),erlangian(k,mean) return double; poisson(mean) returns long.

合格基準: Reference helpers accept mutable long* seed and long parameters: uniform(start,end),normal(mean,deviation),exponential(mean),chi_square(df),t(df),erlangian(k,mean) return double; poisson(mean) returns long.

規定の性質: `definition`。

### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-NORMAL

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

normal repeatedly draws two uniform(-1,1) values until squared-radius s satisfies 0<s<1,then returns v1*sqrt(-2*log(s)/s)*deviation+mean; draw order is preserved.

合格基準: normal repeatedly draws two uniform(-1,1) values until squared-radius s satisfies 0<s<1,then returns v1*sqrt(-2*log(s)/s)*deviation+mean; draw order is preserved.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-NORMAL-ROUND

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

rtl_dist_normal always invokes normal(mean,sd) and rounds nearest with half magnitudes away from zero, with no added deviation-sign guard in this source.

合格基準: rtl_dist_normal always invokes normal(mean,sd) and rounds nearest with half magnitudes away from zero, with no added deviation-sign guard in this source.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-POISSON

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

poisson starts n=0,p=exp(-mean),q=uniform(0,1); while p<q,increment n and multiply q by next uniform sample; return n.

合格基準: poisson starts n=0,p=exp(-mean),q=uniform(0,1); while p<q,increment n and multiply q by next uniform sample; return n.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-SEED-UPDATE-TEXT

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

The supplied C algorithm updates signed long seed by 69069*seed+1,then assigns it to unsigned union storage; retain type and arithmetic-width dependency for interpretation.

合格基準: The supplied C algorithm updates signed long seed by 69069*seed+1,then assigns it to unsigned union storage; retain type and arithmetic-width dependency for interpretation.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。

未解決の解釈: `DISTRIBUTION-C-WIDTH: N.2 uses long,LONG_MIN/LONG_MAX,signed multiplication and unsigned/float union while 20.14.1 requires repeatable 32-bit $random; host long width and signed overflow are not portable C semantics. Oracle needs documented fixed-width interpretation rather than native compilation on arbitrary hosts.`（対応承認・節完了を保留）。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-T

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

t first draws chi_square,divides by df,takes square root,then draws standard normal and divides by root; preserve sampling order.

合格基準: t first draws chi_square,divides by df,takes square root,then draws standard normal and divides by root; preserve sampling order.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-UNIFORM-END

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

For end!=LONG_MAX,increment upper endpoint before uniform sample; convert nonnegative r by truncation,negative r by truncating r-1,then clamp to original inclusive start/end.

合格基準: For end!=LONG_MAX,increment upper endpoint before uniform sample; convert nonnegative r by truncation,negative r by truncating r-1,then clamp to original inclusive start/end.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-UNIFORM-FULL

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

For full LONG_MIN..LONG_MAX,transform (uniform+2147483648)/4294967295,then multiply by 4294967296 and subtract 2147483648,before sign-dependent integer conversion.

合格基準: For full LONG_MIN..LONG_MAX,transform (uniform+2147483648)/4294967295,then multiply by 4294967296 and subtract 2147483648,before sign-dependent integer conversion.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。


### SV2023-N.2-EXTRACT-UNIFORM-MAX

N.2 / normal / テスト未対応

For end=LONG_MAX and start!=LONG_MIN,decrement start,sample uniform then add one,convert by same sign-dependent rule and clamp to original inclusive bounds.

合格基準: For end=LONG_MAX and start!=LONG_MIN,decrement start,sample uniform then add one,convert by same sign-dependent rule and clamp to original inclusive bounds.

規定の性質: `mandatory`。
